name: Jira
description: Your Jira issues and its search, read right in Quick Open, from your Jira Cloud site with an API token of yours.

preferences.title: Site
preferences.description: Your Jira Cloud site's address, as in your browser: yourcompany.atlassian.net.

preferences.title: Email
preferences.description: Your Atlassian account's email, the one the API token is yours by.

preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Make one at id.atlassian.com › Security › API tokens › Create API token (not the one with scopes): it can see what your account can. It's used only to ask your site.
